name: Answer the premise that carries a proposal

uses.action: Move to the other lectern, use its signed work or audience evidence, and let a listener repeat what the first proposal settled and what they would still have to do.

name: Keep short and full references tied to the same record

uses.action: Carry the catalogue identifier and checked MLA reference to either reading position. Follow the chosen arrangement back to the catalogue record for the photograph.
Check the painting’s catalogue data, separate the visitor's inference, and watch a later reader follow the short reference to a full source entry.
